speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I'm not exactly looking forward to working — I'm looking forward to earning money.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I don't want to work for others doing jobs that aren't my type, you know.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: What I'm eager for is the autonomy and the financial independence that work brings.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I look forward to creating value for people and getting paid in return — whether that's through employment or my own ventures.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: In short, I anticipate the outcomes that work enables, not the work itself.
